ceilingBasis.heavyValidation: Authorization ceiling only: up to 3 builds x 3 Cargo jobs. Admit against measured CPU, linker/test peak memory and I/O; tools/delivery/jobs.py heavy_lock remains exclusive until a verified shared admission implementation replaces it.
ceilingBasis.rustTestThreads: Up to 4 per build; include test subprocess fan-out and actual concurrent memory/CPU usage. This number alone does not prove the workload fits.
ceilingBasis.agentCeiling: 96 is a ceiling, not a target or measured execution count. Follow docs/AGENT_STRATEGY_V2.md: useful expert implementation ownership, actual provider/harness limits and resource admission. No invented jobs to fill slots.

bottleneckPolicy.rule: A ceiling may only exist for a measured physical resource (cores, memory, disk, provider concurrency, evaluator independence). Any ceiling that exists only for coordination comfort must be raised to the measured limit or removed.
bottleneckPolicy.integrationWritersRationale: Four parallel preparation lanes are authorized, not four concurrent canonical index/ref writers. Final publication shares a global atomic guarded ff-only transaction. The delivery engine still has one integration_turn until a verified runtime change enables parallel preparation.
bottleneckPolicy.candidateHighWaterRationale: 48 is the configured cap, not proof of throughput. Refill useful independent work continuously and shift capacity toward aged review/build/integration queues; physical resource admission remains binding.
bottleneckPolicy.independentReviewIsNotABottleneck: Review separation (author != reviewer) is a correctness invariant, not a concurrency limit. It must still be honoured at any parallelism.

worktreeLifecycle.rule: Deletion requires merged-and-pushed proof AND inactive ownership, absence of unique ignored/untracked work, frozen-ref/canonical/remote-path exclusions, evidence retention and immediate race rechecks. See docs/AGENT_STRATEGY_V2.md section 8. Current reclaim script is report-only until missing guards are implemented and verified.
order: verify tip is ancestor of main-v2
verify tip is advertised or an ancestor of freshly advertised push-remote main-v2 (ls-remote alone lists only ref tips)
verify inactive task/lease/process ownership, all unique content, frozen refs and path identity
retain required evidence and recheck under lifecycle coordination immediately before removal
report actually reclaimed bytes after successful removals
neverDelete: worktrees whose branch tip is absent from the push remote
dirty worktrees with uncommitted or untracked user work
